title: Diagnostics tests assert a 1 s EXIT_FLUSH under load and fail the full gate intermittently
outcome: Diagnostics tests assert a 1 s EXIT_FLUSH under load and fail the full gate intermittently
acceptance: Root cause of the two failures in full gate test-11888305 is diagnosed and recorded: whether the 1 s EXIT_FLUSH bound in tests (src/diagnostics.rs:18) is a test defect under host contention or a product defect in the diagnostics sink/writer flush

diagnostics::mcp::tests::routing::actual_rmcp_cancellation_releases_slots_and_quarantine_overflow_fails_closed and host::tests::diagnostics::diagnostics_control_parse_refusal_is_queued_before_failed_response_delivery pass deterministically, without loosening what they prove, and the full gate passes

completion.summary: Diagnosed the diagnostics retention tests' contention-sensitive use of the best-effort one-second exit allowance. Added a finite test completion watchdog while preserving exact retained-record/privacy/order assertions and deliberate short-budget failures; extracted the private wait loop without production behavior changes. Full gate, independent Codex/Claude review and independent acceptance passed; installed and fast-forward pushed the clean build. One test-only late-ack discrimination Low retained as independent follow-up w-aad3ab555322.
